scene: The spiralling belt carries you up onto the breezy factory roof transit hub.
picture: A wide side-scrolling view along the factory roof. On the far left, a neon escalator glides upward. In the centre, a wicker bamboo cable car sits open along a wire. On the right, the player in red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands beside a giant moored paper-lantern balloon basket on the far right.
shown: a humming, neon-lit rooftop escalator ascending into mist on the far left
a woven bamboo cable car swaying gently on its overhead wire at centre
a giant glowing paper-lantern hot-air balloon moored to a bollard on the far right
